messages:
mira: quick heads-up — brought up quantized reranker v2 on staging. nDCG is basically flat but MRR on long queries (>80 tokens) dropped ~4%. Anyone seen this kind of length-dependent MRR hit after PTQ?
ryan: hm. first suspects: tokenizer differences or candidate ordering nondet. did the eval harness use the exact same tokenization/seed?
dia: ran a tiny smoke earlier — scores look more compressed for long doc candidates under int4, looks like calibration shift rather than rank inversion.
sam: also check priming/anchoring text changes. and — silly but true — was prefix/kv cache enabled in the quant run? staging sometimes flips that flag for quick bringups.
mira: good catch. the staging job had `--disable-prefix-cache` (we were testing memory). i'll repro with cache on.
ryan: while reproing, run per-length slices (0-20, 21-80, >80) for both float baseline and quant. also check tie-breaker logic (we had a tiebreak refactor recently).
dia: i'll queue a slice-run now. command i'm using: `python eval.py --model rerank_v2_quant --split holdout --slice length:gt:80 --seed 42 --cache-enabled`
sam: add int8 and fp16 runs for comparison. if int8 matches fp32 but int4 doesn't, that's a quant floor issue. also confirm candidate dedupe sorting is deterministic (we had a nondet key recently).
mira: created issue tracking: #452. for immediate triage, can someone run A/B on 10k long queries with cache on vs off and send per-query delta export?
dia: results preview (will push full CSV in ~15m): with cache disabled MRR_down ~= -4.1%, with cache enabled MRR_down ~= -0.3%. nDCG differences tiny in both.
ryan: interesting — that points at prefix caching interaction. maybe kvpack chunking + int4 kernel misaligns attention state for long contexts.
sam: plan: 1) re-run int4 with cache enabled and deterministic KV packing flags, 2) repro on float kernel but same cache flags to rule out harness, 3) run canary with cache enabled if reproduces. I'll get the int4/deterministic run queued.
mira: thanks. if the canary shows stable MRR with cache on, we'll enable cache in the canary rollout and keep the old config for float as fallback policy. ping me when the CSV is up. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary rollout for rerank_v2_quant started on 3 instances (zone-a). monitoring NDCG/MRR & latency.
ryan: also reminder — add per-route latency and token-cost deltas to the A/B so product teams can evaluate econ impact.
mira: noted. appreciate the quick turnaround — will post summary and next steps once the full slice CSV is uploaded to the issue.
